items.question: What ritual sequence must the foremost mantra practitioner follow when performing the burning act?
premises: An offering must be made according to prescribed rule.
The burning act occurs after the offering is completed.
The foremost mantra practitioner is the designated agent of burning.
items.inference: Therefore the foremost mantra practitioner should perform the burning only after duly making the offering according to rule.
uncertainties: The specific object of nivedya and nirdahet is not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having duly offered according to rule, the foremost mantra practitioner should afterwards perform the burning.
